sentences.text: Të dielën në mëngjes Luani është te Sami. Ata pinë çaj.
sentences.english: On Sunday morning Luan is at Sam's. They drink tea.

sentences.text: — Sam, çfarë bëre dje? pyet Luani. Si e kalove ditën?
sentences.english: "Sam, what did you do yesterday?" asks Luan. "How did you spend the day?"

sentences.text: — E kalova mirë! Dje isha në festën e Gjergjit, thotë Sam.
sentences.english: "I spent it well! Yesterday I was at Gjergj's party," says Sam.

sentences.text: — Mira më dërgoi një mesazh dhe më ftoi me një ftesë.
sentences.english: "Mira sent me a message and invited me with an invitation."

sentences.text: — Pastaj e telefonova. Pas telefonatës Dritani më shpjegoi rrugën.
sentences.english: "Then I phoned her. After the call Dritan explained the way to me."

sentences.text: — Si u nise? pyet Luani.
sentences.english: "How did you set out?" asks Luan.

sentences.text: — U nisa në orën dy. Prej shtëpisë te ndalesa eca dhjetë minuta.
sentences.english: "I set out at two o'clock. From the house to the stop I walked ten minutes."

sentences.text: — Linja tetë pati vonesë. Prita dhjetë minuta atje.
sentences.english: "Line eight was late. I waited ten minutes there."

sentences.text: — Pastaj erdhi furgoni. Shoferi ishte i shpejtë.
sentences.english: "Then the minibus came. The driver was fast."

sentences.text: — Mora biletën dhe zbrita në stacion. Arrita në qendër të qytetit në orën tre.
sentences.english: "I took the ticket and got off at the station. I arrived in the centre of the city at three."

sentences.text: — Dritani më priti me makinë. Ai më takoi te stacioni.
sentences.english: "Dritan waited for me with his car. He met me at the station."

sentences.text: — Si arritët në mal? pyet Luani.
sentences.english: "How did you get to the mountain?" asks Luan.

sentences.text: — Dritani më tregoi hartën. Kërkuam adresën bashkë.
sentences.english: "Dritan showed me the map. We looked for the address together."

sentences.text: — Restoranti ndodhet mbi një kodër, afër pyllit.
sentences.english: "The restaurant is on a hill, near the forest."

sentences.text: — Makina shkoi drejt, pastaj bëri një kthesë majtas.
sentences.english: "The car went straight, then made a turn to the left."

sentences.text: — Në kryqëzim ne shikuam adresën. Ajo ishte djathtas.
sentences.english: "At the crossroads we looked at the address. It was on the right."

sentences.text: — Dritani u nis shpejt në drejtim të pyllit.
sentences.english: "Dritan set off quickly in the direction of the forest."

sentences.text: — Nuk ishte larg. Arrita shpejt.
sentences.english: "It was not far. I arrived quickly."

sentences.text: Luani pyet: — Kush ishte atje?
sentences.english: Luan asks: "Who was there?"

sentences.text: — Mira, Dritani, Gjergji dhe shumë shokë. Takova shumë njerëz.
sentences.english: "Mira, Dritan, Gjergj and many friends. I met many people."

sentences.text: — Dërgova një urim për Gjergjin. Ai ishte shumë i lumtur.
sentences.english: "I sent a good wish for Gjergj. He was very happy."

sentences.text: — Si ishte festa? pyet Luani.
sentences.english: "How was the party?" asks Luan.

sentences.text: — E bukur! Hëngrëm supë, mish dhe peshk. Piva një çaj.
sentences.english: "Beautiful! We ate soup, meat and fish. I drank a tea."

sentences.text: — Gjergji më tregoi shokët e tij. Ai më pyeti: A flet shqip?
sentences.english: "Gjergj showed me his friends. He asked me: Do you speak Albanian?"

sentences.text: — Unë thashë: Po, flas pak. Të gjithë dëgjuan dhe buzëqeshën.
sentences.english: "I said: Yes, I speak a little. Everyone listened and smiled."

sentences.text: — Mira më dha një pjatë me ëmbëlsirë.
sentences.english: "Mira gave me a plate with dessert."

sentences.text: — Dritani foli me mua për punën dhe për shkollën.
sentences.english: "Dritan talked with me about work and about school."

sentences.text: — Pas drekës eca pak në pyll me Gjergjin.
sentences.english: "After lunch I walked a little in the forest with Gjergj."

sentences.text: — Mira mbeti në restorant me shokët e saj.
sentences.english: "Mira stayed in the restaurant with her friends."

sentences.text: — Festa mbaroi në orën gjashtë.
sentences.english: "The party ended at six."

sentences.text: — Si u ktheve në shtëpi? pyet Luani.
sentences.english: "How did you get back home?" asks Luan.

sentences.text: — Prej festës shkova me Dritanin. Ai më dërgoi te stacioni.
sentences.english: "From the party I went with Dritan. He took me to the station."

sentences.text: — U ktheva me furgon.
sentences.english: "I went back by minibus."

sentences.text: — Por kur u ktheva te shtëpia, mbeta jashtë. Harrova çelësin brenda!
sentences.english: "But when I got back to the house, I stayed outside. I had forgotten the key inside!"

sentences.text: — Atëherë kujtova Anën. Ajo ka një çelës.
sentences.english: "Then I remembered Ana. She has a key."

sentences.text: — Telefonova numrin e saj në celular.
sentences.english: "I phoned her number on my phone."

sentences.text: — Atëherë Ana erdhi shpejt me çelësin.
sentences.english: "Then Ana came quickly with the key."

sentences.text: — Mbeta atje edhe një orë me të. Atëherë pushova në kopsht.
sentences.english: "I stayed there another hour with her. Then I rested in the garden."

sentences.text: — Prej Dritanit kam edhe një mesazh. Ai e harroi librin tim në makinë.
sentences.english: "I also have a message from Dritan. He forgot my book in the car."

sentences.text: Luani buzëqesh: — Kalove një ditë të gjatë!
sentences.english: Luan smiles: "You spent a long day!"

sentences.text: — Po. Sot jam i dobët dhe kam dhimbje në këmbë.
sentences.english: "Yes. Today I am weak and my feet hurt."

sentences.text: — Pi një ilaç dhe fle, thotë Luani.
sentences.english: "Take a medicine and sleep," says Luan.

sentences.text: — Mos harro: nesër ke një takim në orën tetë.
sentences.english: "Do not forget: tomorrow you have a meeting at eight."

sentences.text: — Po, e kujtoj, thotë Sam.
sentences.english: "Yes, I remember," says Sam.

sentences.text: — Ku ndodhet takimi? pyet Luani.
sentences.english: "Where is the meeting?" asks Luan.

sentences.text: — Në qendër, afër stacionit. Nuk e kujtoj rrugën.
sentences.english: "In the centre, near the station. I do not remember the street."

sentences.text: — Ku ndodhesh ti pasdite? pyet Sam. Mund të vish me mua?
sentences.english: "Where are you in the afternoon?" asks Sam. "Can you come with me?"

sentences.text: — Po, vij me ty. Unë mbaroj në orën pesë. Kur mbaroj punën, pushoj pak.
sentences.english: "Yes, I will come with you. I finish at five. When I finish work, I rest a little."

sentences.text: — Pse nuk pushon edhe ti, Sam?
sentences.english: "Why do you not rest too, Sam?"

sentences.text: — Në mbrëmje do të fle. Sot nuk dua të ec shumë.
sentences.english: "In the evening I will sleep. Today I do not want to walk much."
